summary: Ontario fire tower on Tower Road, Thessalon; a 2014 photo caption describes the steel tower still standing, but an undated visit found it gone.

facts.status_note: A 2014 photo caption describes the steel tower still standing; a visitor's undated report says it is gone.

events.note: Photo captioned 'Macreights Dam Tower in Thessalon' (May 2002) with its ladder sawed off to stop climbing; a photo record, not a register listing

notes_for_editor: Identity is the main open question. The index entry (Thessalon Fire Tower) and the photographers' McCreight's Fire Tower near McCreights Pond are not stated to be the same structure in any source read. The record's coordinates come from the Ontario geoHub tower layer (local copy: ontario_lio/fire_towers.geojson), where the point is described as 'East side of McCreights Pond', an MNR fire tower, verified, within 50 m. That text is not quoted because the geoHub web page does not expose it to the reader. Status conflicts: the record and the index say gone; a 2014 photo caption says the steel tower and shed stood, and the index visitor's report is undated. Locations also conflict: 10 km north of Thessalon versus 5 km north of Little Rapids (both Flickr captions). The 30.5 m height comes from one caption and may apply to a different tower if the identity fails. No build date, builder, staffing or fire record was found in two searches and the cached pages, so none is stated. Access is unknown; nothing says whether the land is public.
